parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the door of the safe, made of solid steel, forming the front opening panel of the safe.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main barrier to protect the contents inside the safe, locking securely when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge axis to open and close, allowing access to the interior compartment.

parts.name: Switch (Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle or rotating switch of the safe, made of steel, located on the door front.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to engage or disengage the locking mechanism, allowing the door to be opened or secured.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis to operate the internal locking bolts.

parts.name: Switch (Dial)
parts.Basic_description: This is the combination dial of the safe, made of steel, positioned on the door surface.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to input a combination code to unlock the safe mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates smoothly to align internal tumblers or digital sensors for unlocking.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the safe, made of thick steel walls forming the structural enclosure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main protective housing for the contents, resisting physical attacks and fire.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, serving as the fixed frame for the door and locking components.
